PDF_to_Markdown.paper_basis: Datasheets are converted from PDF to Markdown with table preservation.
PDF_to_Markdown.reproduction: Uses the project's existing MinerU Markdown instead of the paper's TextIn API 2.1.

AGDF.paper_basis: Search globally, show candidate datasheets, let the user select one, and constrain later retrieval to that document.
AGDF.reproduction: Scores the three sample documents and locks the manifest-selected target.

HDER.paper_basis: Predict primary and supplementary parameter-rich sections and prioritize retrieval inside them.
HDER.reproduction: Ranks headings by section prior and parameter-term coverage and retains top-8.

HNEN.paper_location: Section 3.2C, Figures 4-5, and Appendix C, PDF pages 5 and 10
HNEN.paper_basis: Normalize misspelled model names, parameter names, and section titles, then retry retrieval.
HNEN.reproduction: Uses a declared synonym map and records which aliases occur in the locked document.

SPICE_generation.paper_location: Section 3.3, Figure 6, and Table III, PDF pages 5-7
SPICE_generation.paper_basis: Classify into one of five device types, select a fixed type template, retrieve required values and condition variants, then populate the template.
SPICE_generation.reproduction: Uses the exact diode and MOSFET field lists reported in Table III; all value sources and derivations are recorded.

validation.paper_location: Section 4.3, Table III, and Appendix E, PDF pages 7 and 11-13
validation.paper_basis: Use an RC high-pass filter for diodes and a common-source amplifier for MOSFETs; Appendix E uses 1 Hz-1 GHz with 500 logarithmic points.
validation.reproduction: Recomputes the paper equations, writes the 500-point sweep, and additionally checks SPICE loading with ngspice.
